comment: The release archives of the template release that hyper uses (kit K140, H23.11-2): the php-ext zip, which make install unpacks into var/products/template-ext for make ext, and the php zip in the Composer artifact repository var/products/template-php of composer.json and examples/board/composer.json. TEMPLATE_TAG of the Makefile reads the version of template-php. template-php-consumer is the php zip of the template release that the published hyper release of the consumer projects of tests/release-install requires; release-consumer puts it into the artifact repository of the Composer consumer (consumers.composer.polyspec of config/release.json, H23.11-1), and the release whose archives require another template release moves it with the consumer locks (H21.4).
